summary: Well-structured, comprehensive test suite with strong unit-level edge case coverage (boundary testing, policy composition, input validation, type coercion). Good separation of concerns across Unit/Acceptance/Workflow test files with appropriate use of Pester features (tagging, parameterization, helpers). Acceptance tests validate GitHub Actions integration via act with 3 parameterized cases. Workflow tests ensure YAML structure and actionlint compliance. Gaps: acceptance tests cover only happy-path scenarios—no negative test cases (malformed JSON, missing fields, or error conditions in Docker); limited to 3 concrete integration cases due to act runtime budget; some edge cases untested (scaling, artifact count extremes, fixture path env-var precedence). DeleteAction invocation in live mode tested only at unit level. Would reliably catch regressions in core retention logic and workflow structure, but might miss integration-level error handling.
